_comment: The Event Deck: CLASSIFIED DILEMMAS. At the end of each week, if no dilemma was drawn in the last
min_weeks_between weeks, a card is drawn with draw_chance. The card is shown as a modal pop-up and the game
cannot advance until the Lord Protector chooses. Cards are not drawn twice unless `repeatable`.
Card: id, title, category, weight, text (flavour, {placeholders} as in emails), conditions, choices.
conditions (all optional): seasons [Winter|Spring|Summer|Autumn], min_turn, requires_research (a project is
running), requires_battle (a battle is being fought), requires_flag / forbids_flag.
choices: 2-3 of {id, label, hint (shown under the button), effects}. Effects use the email effect keys:
treasury, manpower, population, morale, military_morale, tax_rate, stockpiles {resource: n}, flags {name: v},
ai_tension (hidden), equipment {item: n} (national stockpile), army_morale (every formation),
modifier {key, value, weeks} (e.g. factory_efficiency +0.15 for 4 weeks), research_weeks (current project).

Expansion 1.1 conditions: requires_relation {nation: min}, requires_trade <nation>, requires_city_without {city, building}. Effects: relations / rival_relations {nation: delta}, build {city, building}, city_morale {city: delta}.

EVENT CHAINS: a choice may carry follow_ups, same schema as email follow-ups with `card` for `email`: [{card, delay_weeks}] or [{delay_weeks, chance, outcomes: [{card, weight}]}]. Cards marked chain_only are only ever scheduled. Generated/extended by tools/generate_massive_deck.py.

cards.title: Strike at the Ironvale Steelworks
cards.text:
Forty thousand steelworkers at the Ironvale and Kessel works have downed tools. They demand bread rations restored to pre-war levels and an end to the seventy-hour week. Pickets have closed the rolling mills; the shell presses stand silent.

The Minister of Internal Affairs has two battalions of Internal Troops on the trains and awaits your word. The Minister of Labour begs you to listen to the men first.

choices.label: Crush it
choices.hint: Troops clear the pickets. Quotas are enforced at bayonet point.

choices.label: Concede
choices.hint: Restore the rations and shorten the week. The treasury pays.

choices.label: Appoint an arbitrator
choices.hint: Talks drag on; the mills run at half speed meanwhile.

cards.title: A Vosk Jet Lands at Harrow
cards.text:
At dawn a Vosk strike fighter touched down on the Harrow airfield with its guns cold. The pilot, a Guards captain, asks for asylum. He has brought his aircraft, his codebooks, and a grudge against the Chairman.

Karzan is already demanding his return and calling it an act of piracy.

choices.label: Debrief him in secret
choices.hint: Our analysts will read Vosk signals traffic for months.

choices.label: Send him back
choices.hint: A gesture of goodwill. The officers' mess will not forgive it.

choices.label: Parade him on newsreel
choices.hint: A propaganda triumph at home; Karzan will be enraged.

cards.title: Bread Queues in Aldmark
cards.text: The flour ration failed to arrive in three districts of the capital this week. Queues formed before dawn and ended in scuffles with the police; a baker's shop on Canal Street was looted. Housewives are chanting outside the Ministry of Supply.

choices.label: Open the state granaries
choices.hint: Grain from the strategic reserve feeds the city.

choices.label: Tighten rationing
choices.hint: The army keeps its bread. The people go hungry.

choices.label: Buy grain through Iren
choices.hint: Neutral merchants charge wartime prices.

cards.title: The General Staff Wants More Men
cards.text: The Adjutant-General reports the replacement pool will not sustain current losses. He proposes lowering the draft age to seventeen and ending the exemptions for university students and skilled workers.

choices.label: Lower the draft age
choices.hint: Fifteen thousand more men. Mothers march on the Assembly.

choices.label: End student exemptions only
choices.hint: A smaller levy, a smaller outcry.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: The generals will say you do not want to win.

cards.title: A Merchant of Death in Iren
cards.text: A broker in the Iren Free Port offers war materiel from undisclosed sources: small arms, heavy shells, even airframes with the serial numbers ground off. Payment in gold, delivery by neutral freighter, no questions asked.

choices.label: Buy rifles and shells
choices.hint: 3,000 rifles and 3,000 152mm shells into our depots.

choices.label: Buy the airframes
choices.hint: Twelve strike fighters and fuel for them.

choices.label: Decline
choices.hint: Keep our gold and our hands clean.

cards.title: A Mole in the War Ministry
cards.text: Counter-intelligence has traced a leak to the Ministry of War: a colonel on the planning staff meets a Vosk courier every Thursday in the Aldmark botanical gardens. Our operational plans have been read in Karzan for months.

choices.label: Arrest the whole planning staff
choices.hint: Thorough. The officer corps will be terrified.

choices.label: Feed him false plans
choices.hint: Let Karzan believe we are weaker and more timid than we are.

choices.label: Watch and wait
choices.hint: The leak continues.

cards.title: The War Bond Drive
cards.text: The Treasury proposes a national war bond campaign: posters, radio appeals, factory quotas for subscriptions. The more ambitious version would make subscription compulsory for every household with savings.

choices.label: A patriotic campaign
choices.hint: Voluntary subscriptions; modest but willing.

choices.label: Compulsory loans
choices.hint: Every savings book in the Commonwealth is tapped.

choices.label: Not now
choices.hint: The people have given enough.

cards.title: The Laboratories Ask for More
cards.text: The Director of Research & Development requests emergency funds to put the current project on a war footing: triple shifts, requisitioned university laboratories, and priority on scarce instruments.

choices.label: Fund a crash program
choices.hint: Four weeks of work in one stroke.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: The labs work at their own pace.

cards.title: Convoy Trapped in the Snow
cards.text: A fuel convoy of three hundred trucks bound for the Eastmarch is stranded in drifts on the Ironvale road. The drivers are burning the cargo to stay alive. The front is waiting for that fuel.

choices.label: Send the engineers
choices.hint: Snowploughs and labour battalions dig them out, at a price.

choices.label: Let them dig in
choices.hint: Most of the fuel is burnt before spring. The front goes short.

choices.label: Supply them by air
choices.hint: Transport sorties burn aviation fuel but save the convoy.

cards.title: General Mud
cards.text: The Rasputitsa has turned every road into a river of mud. Staff officers propose requisitioning farm tractors from the collective farms to haul guns and supplies. The Ministry of Agriculture warns it will ruin the harvest.

choices.label: Requisition the tractors
choices.hint: The army moves; the farms do not.

choices.label: Wait for firm ground
choices.hint: The generals chafe at the delay.

cards.title: Unrest in the Fleet
cards.text: Sailors of the Home Fleet have refused to take their ships out in protest at spoiled rations and unpaid sea allowance. Red flags were briefly seen at the masthead of a destroyer at Port Cassel.

choices.label: Pay the allowances
choices.hint: The grievance is settled.

choices.label: Court-martial the ringleaders
choices.hint: Discipline is restored. Resentment festers.

cards.title: The Casualty Lists
cards.text: The Aldmark Herald has obtained the full casualty lists from the Frontier and intends to print them tomorrow, with photographs. The editor is a war hero with friends in the Assembly.

choices.label: Seize the presses
choices.hint: The lists are never printed. Rumour fills the silence.

choices.label: Let them print
choices.hint: Honest grief. The country mourns.

choices.label: Answer with a heroic newsreel
choices.hint: The Ministry of Information goes to work.

cards.title: Typhus at the Front
cards.text: The Frontier Army's medical service reports typhus spreading through the forward trenches. Lice, cold and exhaustion; two field hospitals are already overwhelmed.

choices.label: Quarantine and delousing
choices.hint: Expensive, disruptive, effective.

choices.label: Keep the line manned
choices.hint: Men die in their dugouts.

cards.title: A Feeler from Karzan
cards.text: Through the Iren consulate, a man claiming to speak for the Vosk Politburo proposes secret talks: a ceasefire in place, prisoners exchanged, the Frontier demilitarised. He may be sincere. He may be buying time.

choices.label: Explore it quietly
choices.hint: Tension may fall. The generals will call it treason.

choices.label: Reject it publicly
choices.hint: The nation rallies; Karzan loses face.

choices.label: Leak it to the press
choices.hint: Embarrass Karzan abroad; alarm our own people.

cards.title: A Bumper Harvest
cards.text: The Ministry of Agriculture reports the best harvest in a decade. The granaries are full to bursting and neutral buyers in Iren are offering hard currency.

choices.label: Export the surplus
choices.hint: Hard currency for the war chest.

choices.label: Harvest festivals
choices.hint: Bread, beer and bunting. The people remember what they fight for.

cards.title: Sabotage on the Eastmarch Line
cards.text: Partisans have blown a culvert under the main Eastmarch railway. Two ammunition trains were derailed. The local police chief suspects the villagers of Halden sheltered the saboteurs.

choices.label: Collective reprisals
choices.hint: Hostages are taken. The sabotage stops — for now.

choices.label: Repair and patrol
choices.hint: Railway troops and lost shells.

cards.title: Oakhaven Wants a Consideration
cards.text: The Oakhaven trade attaché has let it be known, over brandy, that certain members of the Republic's Senate Commerce Committee are 'reconsidering' the agreement with Kestria. A consideration of forty thousand, paid into an account in Vael, would settle their doubts.

choices.label: Pay the consideration
choices.hint: Grease the wheels. Nobody need ever know.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: Kestria does not pay bribes. The Senate may remember.

choices.label: Leak it to the Oakhaven press
choices.hint: A scandal in the Republic; a principled stand at home.

cards.title: Aldmark Workers Strike for a Hospital
cards.text: Twenty thousand workers of the Aldmark arsenals have walked out. Their families are dying in corridors of the old infirmary; they want a modern hospital, and they want it now. The Minister of Munitions warns that the shell lines will stand idle until they get an answer.

choices.label: Build the hospital
choices.hint: The state pays; construction starts at once.

choices.label: Promise one after the war
choices.hint: The men go back grumbling.

choices.label: Break the strike
choices.hint: Police clear the gates; production resumes with a vengeance.

cards.title: Tor Weighs an Embargo
cards.text: Vosk envoys have been received with honours in the Toran capital. The Protector-General is weighing an embargo on arms and fuel to Kestria. Tor respects strength and money; it has never cared for sentiment.

choices.label: Send a delegation
choices.hint: Dinners, speeches and a very good wine cellar.

choices.label: Offer Tor harbour concessions at Greyhaven
choices.hint: Toran merchants get free berths; Kestrian dockers do not like it.

choices.label: Let them vote
choices.hint: Tor will do what Tor does.

cards.title: The Oakhaven Volunteer Squadron
cards.text: A group of Oakhaven airmen — veterans, adventurers, idealists — have crossed the ocean with their own aircraft and ask to fly for Kestria. Their government winks. Karzan will howl.

choices.label: Welcome the volunteers
choices.hint: Eight fighters and their pilots join our air force.

choices.label: Send them home
choices.hint: Kestria will not drag the Republic into the war.

cards.title: A Vaelish Medical Mission
cards.text: The Council of Savants of Vael offers to send surgeons, nurses and a complete field hospital to Greywater, if Kestria pays their passage and guarantees their neutrality.

choices.label: Accept the mission
choices.hint: A modern hospital for Greywater and goodwill in Vael.

choices.label: Decline with thanks
choices.hint: Foreign doctors ask too many questions.

cards.title: Arms for the Enemy
cards.text: Naval intelligence has tracked three Toran freighters loaded with shells and fuel, bound for Sevrask under a neutral flag. Our destroyers could stop them on the high seas.

choices.label: Seize the freighters
choices.hint: Their cargo becomes ours. Tor will be furious.

choices.label: Protest through diplomatic channels
choices.hint: Embarrass Tor into stopping the trade.

choices.label: Let them sail
choices.hint: Neutral shipping is neutral shipping.

cards.title: The Kessel Works Quota
cards.text: The Ministry of Munitions has raised the Kessel Works quota by a third. Foremen report women fainting at the shell presses after fourteen-hour shifts; the TNT dust has turned their skin yellow. The works director asks for the Lord Protector's decision: hold the quota, or let the lines slow.

choices.label: Hold the quota
choices.hint: Every shell counts. The women are paid for their sacrifice.

choices.label: Cut the shifts to ten hours
choices.hint: The front will wait a little longer for its shells.

choices.label: Send in convict labour
choices.hint: Internal Security has prisoners to spare.

cards.title: Explosion at the Kessel Works
cards.text: At 03:10 the filling shed of Line Four went up. Windows broke in Ironvale, eleven miles away. Rescue teams are still pulling women from the rubble; the dead number in the hundreds. The survivors say the line was running too fast for anyone to follow the safety drill.

choices.label: Blame Vosk saboteurs
choices.hint: Internal Security will find someone to hang.

choices.label: Compensate the families
choices.hint: Pensions for the widowers, a memorial in the square.

choices.label: Suppress the news
choices.hint: The censors will call it an industrial accident.

cards.title: Sabotage on the Filling Lines
cards.text: Fuse caps filled with sand, detonators wired backwards: the convict gangs at the Kessel Works have been quietly ruining a tenth of what they touch. The gunners at the front have noticed.

choices.label: Hang the ringleaders
choices.hint: An example for the others.

choices.label: Send them back to the camps
choices.hint: Lose the labour; keep the shells good.

cards.title: The Black Market
cards.text: Butter at forty times the ration price, petrol in whisky bottles, army boots in the flea markets: the black market has taken over the back streets of Aldmark. The Director of Internal Security wants authority to shoot profiteers on sight.

choices.label: Shoot the profiteers
choices.hint: Public executions on Canal Street.

choices.label: License small traders
choices.hint: Tax what cannot be stopped.

choices.label: Look the other way
choices.hint: It keeps the city fed, after a fashion.

cards.title: The Rail-Yard Cartel
cards.text: Left alone, the black market has organised. A cartel of railwaymen and quartermasters now skims one wagon in twenty from the military trains out of Aldmark yards, and the fuel dumps at the front are running dry.

choices.label: Raid the yards
choices.hint: Military police, a night, and no warrants.

choices.label: Buy them into the war effort
choices.hint: Their networks can move what the army cannot.

cards.title: Refugees on the Greywater Road
cards.text: Tens of thousands of refugees from the Eastmarch are streaming into Greywater with carts, cattle and nothing else. The town council demands a hospital, soup kitchens and somewhere to put them before the winter kills them in the fields.

choices.label: Build a hospital and shelters
choices.hint: The state pays; Greywater will remember.

choices.label: Put up tent camps
choices.hint: Cheap, fast, and crowded.

choices.label: Turn them back east
choices.hint: Keep the roads clear for the army.

cards.title: Typhus in the Camps
cards.text: The tent camps outside Greywater are full of lice, and the lice are full of typhus. The camp doctors have run out of everything.

choices.label: Delousing stations and a quarantine line
choices.hint: Expensive, and it may be too late.

choices.label: Burn the camps and scatter the refugees
choices.hint: The fever goes with them.

cards.title: The Bells of Aldmark
cards.text: The Ministry of Munitions wants the bronze bells of every church in the capital melted for shell casings. The Bishop of Aldmark has announced that he will chain himself to the cathedral tower.

choices.label: Seize the bells
choices.hint: Bronze is bronze.

choices.label: Spare the bells
choices.hint: Some things are worth more than shells.

choices.label: Take only the small bells
choices.hint: The cathedral keeps its great bell.

cards.title: The University Occupation
cards.text: Students have occupied the Aldmark University great hall with banners reading PEACE NOW and BRING THEM HOME. Internal Security has surrounded the building and awaits orders.

choices.label: Send in Internal Security
choices.hint: Clear the hall before it spreads.

choices.label: Negotiate
choices.hint: Hear them out, promise nothing.

choices.label: Draft the ringleaders
choices.hint: Let them see the trenches for themselves.

cards.title: A Student's Funeral
cards.text: A nineteen-year-old medical student died of his injuries after the university was cleared. His funeral procession is expected to draw fifty thousand people.

choices.label: Ban the procession
choices.hint: Internal Security will hold the bridges.

choices.label: Allow it under guard
choices.hint: Let them grieve, and watch them.

choices.label: The Lord Protector walks behind the coffin
choices.hint: A gesture the generals will not forgive.

cards.title: No Coal for the Cities
cards.text: The frost has come early and the coal ration has failed in half the cities of the Commonwealth. Families are burning floorboards. The Ministry of Fuel can keep either the homes or the steelworks warm, not both.

choices.label: Heat the homes
choices.hint: The steelworks bank their furnaces.

choices.label: Keep the steelworks burning
choices.hint: The people must endure.

choices.label: Buy coal from Tor
choices.hint: At Tor's prices, and Tor's gratitude.

cards.title: The Iron Line
cards.text: The Ministry of Information proposes a great patriotic film: 'The Iron Line', three hours of heroism in the Frontier trenches, with real soldiers as extras and real shells for the barrage scenes.

choices.label: Fund the film
choices.hint: Art is a weapon.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: The shells are needed at the front.

cards.title: 'The Iron Line' Premieres
cards.text: Audiences weep and cheer. Queues stretch around the cinemas of every city. The Oakhaven distributors want the film for the Republic.

choices.label: Export it to Oakhaven
choices.hint: Let the Republic see what Kestria is fighting for.

choices.label: Keep it for the home front
choices.hint: Screen it in every barracks too.

cards.title: 'The Iron Line' Is Laughed Off the Screen
cards.text: The premiere audience howled at the cardboard tanks and the actor-general's wooden speeches. Veterans walked out. The foreign press is having a wonderful time.

choices.label: Blame the director
choices.hint: He will make training films in Harrowfen.

choices.label: Pull it quietly
choices.hint: Every print into the furnace.

cards.title: The War Widows' Pensions
cards.text: The Treasury is eleven weeks behind on war widows' pensions. Three thousand black-clad women are standing in silence outside the Ministry of Finance.

choices.label: Pay them in full
choices.hint: The state keeps its promises.

choices.label: Delay payment
choices.hint: The war comes first.

choices.label: Pay half now
choices.hint: Something is better than nothing.

cards.title: Requisitioning the Harvest
cards.text: The army quartermasters want the whole Harrowfen harvest requisitioned at fixed prices. The farmers say they will burn their ricks first.

choices.label: Requisition it
choices.hint: Soldiers with bayonets at every threshing floor.

choices.label: Buy at market price
choices.hint: Fair, and ruinous.

choices.label: Leave the farmers alone
choices.hint: The army will tighten its belt.

cards.title: Women to the Factories
cards.text: The Ministry of Labour proposes to conscript unmarried women into the munitions industry. The Church, the unions and half the Assembly are outraged; the other half say it is long overdue.

choices.label: Conscript them
choices.hint: Industry needs hands.

choices.label: Call for volunteers
choices.hint: Posters, pay and pride.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: Kestrian women will not be drafted.

cards.title: The Hospital Petition
cards.text: A petition with two hundred thousand signatures demands a modern hospital for Kessel Works, where the munitions workers are dying of TNT poisoning in the old infirmary.

choices.label: Build the hospital
choices.hint: The state pays; construction starts at once.

choices.label: The war comes first
choices.hint: No money for bricks and beds.

cards.title: Draft Dodgers in the Harrowfen
cards.text: Three thousand young men are hiding from the call-up in the Harrowfen marshes, fed by their families and warned by the village priests. The Adjutant-General wants a manhunt.

choices.label: Order the manhunt
choices.hint: Dogs, patrols and hostages.

choices.label: Offer an amnesty
choices.hint: Come in now and nothing will be said.

choices.label: Leave them in the marsh
choices.hint: The army is not short of men — yet.

cards.title: The Dud Shell Scandal
cards.text: Artillery officers report that one shell in five from the latest Kessel Works lots fails to explode. Infantry went over the top last month behind a barrage that never came.

choices.label: Court-martial the inspectors
choices.hint: Heads will roll at the Ministry of Munitions.

choices.label: Cover it up
choices.hint: Nothing must shake faith in Kestrian industry.

choices.label: Buy shells from Tor instead
choices.hint: Toran shells are dear, but they go off.

cards.title: THE HERALD: 'DUD SHELLS KILLED OUR SONS'
cards.text: The Aldmark Herald has the whole story, with a photograph of a crate of dud shells and the inspector's signature on the lot card. The Assembly is in uproar.

choices.label: Sack the Minister of Munitions
choices.hint: A sacrifice to the public.

choices.label: Seize the Herald's presses
choices.hint: The story dies tonight.

cards.title: High Command Proposes the Great Push
cards.text: The General Staff has drawn up plans for a general offensive along the whole Frontier: three days of barrage, then every division over the top at once. They promise to be in Karzan by the harvest.

choices.label: Approve the plan
choices.hint: The generals are delighted; the gunners start stacking shells.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: Kestria will not bleed itself white.

choices.label: Order a further study
choices.hint: Buy time without saying no.

cards.title: Truce in No-Man's-Land
cards.text: On the night of the winter solstice the Vosk trenches began to sing. By morning men of both armies were exchanging cigarettes and photographs in no-man's-land.

choices.label: Court-martial the officers
choices.hint: Fraternisation is treason.

choices.label: Look the other way
choices.hint: One day's peace will not lose the war.

choices.label: Send intelligence officers into the truce
choices.hint: Every Vosk soldier knows something.

cards.title: The Clemency Petition
cards.text: Six men of the 3rd Division, sentenced to death for desertion under fire, are to be shot at dawn. Their mothers have walked from Stanhope to beg for their lives.

choices.label: Let the sentences stand
choices.hint: Discipline is the army.

choices.label: Commute to a penal battalion
choices.hint: They can die usefully.

choices.label: Pardon them
choices.hint: Mercy from the Lord Protector.

cards.title: The March of the Maimed
cards.text: Ten thousand disabled veterans — men on crutches, men with no faces, men pushed in barrows — are marching on Aldmark to demand the pensions they were promised.

choices.label: Grant the pensions
choices.hint: The nation pays its debts.

choices.label: Disperse the march
choices.hint: Mounted police on the bridges.

cards.title: Fire at Harrow Airfield
cards.text: The fuel dump at Harrow airfield exploded last night, taking a hangar and a dozen fighters with it. The base commander says it was an accident; the military police are not so sure.

choices.label: Open an investigation
choices.hint: Find out who, or what.

choices.label: Rebuild and move on
choices.hint: No time for inquiries.

cards.title: The Harrow Saboteur
cards.text: The investigation has found him: a fuel clerk with a Vosk grandmother, a bank account in Vael and a short-wave set in his attic.

choices.label: Hang him publicly
choices.hint: A warning to every traitor.

choices.label: Turn him
choices.hint: He will send Karzan what we want them to hear.

cards.title: Negligence at Harrow
cards.text: No saboteur: a drunk mechanic, a cigarette, and a fuel dump that should never have been sited next to the hangars.

choices.label: Court-martial the base commander
choices.hint: Someone must answer.

choices.label: Keep it quiet
choices.hint: Sabotage sounds better in the newspapers.

cards.title: Oakhaven Threatens an Embargo
cards.text: President Caul's government has sent a stiff note: the Republic cannot continue to trade with a state that taxes its citizens into penury. Unless Kestria lowers its taxes, Oakhaven will suspend the trade agreement and every lend-lease licence.

choices.label: Lower taxes to Normal
choices.hint: Keep the Republic sweet.

choices.label: Refuse the interference
choices.hint: Kestria sets its own taxes.

choices.label: Promise reforms
choices.hint: Words cost nothing — for now.

cards.title: Oakhaven Observers Arrive
cards.text: A delegation from the Oakhaven Senate has arrived to see the promised tax reforms for itself.

choices.label: Show them the truth
choices.hint: Honesty, whatever it costs.

choices.label: Stage a model town
choices.hint: Fresh paint, full shops, happy workers for a day.

choices.label: Lower taxes before they arrive
choices.hint: Keep the promise after all.

cards.title: Tor Offers Cheap Artillery
cards.text: The Protector-General of Tor offers twenty-four new howitzers at half price — if Kestria formally recognises Tor's annexation of the Marish coast. Oakhaven will call it a betrayal of every principle Kestria claims.

choices.label: Buy and recognise the annexation
choices.hint: Guns now, principles later.

choices.label: Offer full price without recognition
choices.hint: Tor may take the money.

choices.label: Decline
choices.hint: Kestria does not trade in other nations' land.

cards.title: Vael Offers Good Offices
cards.text: The Council of Savants of Vael offers to host talks between Kestria and the Hegemony in the neutral city of Aurel: prisoner exchanges first, and perhaps more.

choices.label: Send a delegation
choices.hint: Talking is not surrender.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: There is nothing to discuss with Karzan.

cards.title: Progress at Aurel
cards.text: The Vosk delegation has agreed to a general exchange of prisoners, and hints that more could follow.

choices.label: Sign the prisoner exchange
choices.hint: Thousands of men come home.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.hint: An exchange frees their veterans too.

cards.title: The Aurel Talks Collapse
cards.text: The Vosk delegation walked out after one day, calling Kestria's terms 'an insult to the Hegemony'.

choices.label: Blame Karzan publicly
choices.hint: Let the world see who wants peace.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.hint: Leave the door open.

cards.title: The Protector-General's Visit
cards.text: Protector-General Oskar Tor will pass through Port Cassel on his way home from Oakhaven. His ministers hint that he expects a state reception worthy of a great power — and a gift.

choices.label: A lavish reception
choices.hint: Guards of honour, a banquet, a gold-mounted sabre.

choices.label: A modest welcome
choices.hint: Correct, and cheap.

choices.label: Snub him
choices.hint: Kestria does not grovel to dictators.

cards.title: The Oakhaven War Loan
cards.text: A consortium of Oakhaven banks offers Kestria a war loan of a quarter of a million, repayable with interest in eight weeks. The Treasury is tempted; the Finance Minister is terrified.

choices.label: Take the loan
choices.hint: Money now; the reckoning later.

choices.label: Decline
choices.hint: Kestria will not mortgage its future.

cards.title: The Oakhaven Loan Falls Due
cards.text: The Oakhaven consortium presents its bill: three hundred thousand, principal and interest, payable this week.

choices.label: Repay in full
choices.hint: Kestria pays its debts.

choices.label: Default
choices.hint: Let them sue.

choices.label: Refinance for another eight weeks
choices.hint: Pay the interest, roll the rest.

cards.title: An Oakhaven Journalist at the Front
cards.text: Clara Whitlow of the Oakhaven Evening Standard, the most famous war correspondent in the Republic, asks for a pass to the Frontier trenches.

choices.label: Grant the pass
choices.hint: Let the Republic see the war as it is.

choices.label: Deny it
choices.hint: No foreigners at the front.

cards.title: 'THE LIONS OF THE FRONTIER'
cards.text: Whitlow's dispatches — mud, courage, and quiet Kestrian decency — are front-page news in Oakhaven.

choices.label: Syndicate it everywhere
choices.hint: Every neutral paper should print it.

choices.label: Thank her quietly
choices.hint: Modesty plays well abroad.

cards.title: 'THE BUTCHERS OF THE FRONTIER'
cards.text: Whitlow has written about the field punishments, the dud shells and the penal battalions. The Oakhaven Senate wants hearings.

choices.label: Expel her
choices.hint: She abused Kestrian hospitality.

choices.label: Promise reforms at the front
choices.hint: Fix what she found.

cards.title: Refugee Scientists from Vael
cards.text: A group of Vaelish chemists, quarrelling with their own Council, ask for asylum and laboratories in Kestria. The Council of Savants would regard it as theft.

choices.label: Welcome them
choices.hint: Their knowledge is ours.

choices.label: Send them home
choices.hint: Vael's friendship is worth more.

cards.title: Our Man in Karzan
cards.text: Agent LANTERN-7, our best source inside the Vosk General Staff, has sent an unusual request: a large sum of money and a promise of exfiltration. Counter-intelligence thinks he may have been turned.

choices.label: Trust him
choices.hint: Pay, and keep him in place.

choices.label: Burn him
choices.hint: Cut contact. Lose the source.

cards.title: LANTERN-7 Delivers
cards.text: LANTERN-7's report is pure gold: the Vosk order of battle, the ammunition stocks of the Western Front, and the date of their next offensive.

choices.label: Prepare the defences
choices.hint: Every division stands to.

choices.label: Share it with Oakhaven
choices.hint: Proof that the Hegemony plans aggression.

cards.title: LANTERN-7 Was Turned
cards.text: Everything LANTERN-7 has sent for two months was written in Karzan. Our dispositions on the northern flank were built on Vosk fiction.

choices.label: Purge the intelligence service
choices.hint: Start again from nothing.

choices.label: Feed them lies in return
choices.hint: Two can play.

cards.title: The Codebreakers' Request
cards.text: The cryptanalysts at Stanhope say they are close to breaking the Vosk high-command cipher. They need mathematicians, calculating machines and money.

choices.label: Fund the crash programme
choices.hint: Whatever they need.

choices.label: Not now
choices.hint: The front needs shells more than sums.

cards.title: The Vosk Cipher Is Broken
cards.text: Stanhope has done it: the Vosk high-command traffic is readable. The question is how to use it without revealing that we can.

choices.label: Exploit it quietly
choices.hint: Never act on more than we could have guessed.

choices.label: Reveal Vosk war plans to the world
choices.hint: Shame Karzan in every capital.

cards.title: Emergency Powers for Internal Security
cards.text: The Director of Internal Security asks for powers to detain suspects without trial, open any letter and tap any telephone. 'The Vosk are everywhere,' he says.

choices.label: Grant the powers
choices.hint: Security first.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: Kestria is not the Hegemony.

cards.title: The Ostrakov Operation
cards.text: Our agents propose to assassinate Marshal Ostrakov, commander of the Vosk Western Front, with a bomb in his staff car. The operation needs money and the Lord Protector's signature.

choices.label: Authorise the operation
choices.hint: Decapitate the Western Front.

choices.label: Veto it
choices.hint: Kestria does not murder generals.

cards.title: Marshal Ostrakov Is Dead
cards.text: The bomb went off under the Marshal's car on the Karzan road. The Western Front staff is in chaos, and Karzan is howling for revenge.

choices.label: Let it be known it was us
choices.hint: Terror for their generals.

choices.label: Deny everything
choices.hint: Partisans, perhaps. Who can say?

cards.title: The Agents Are Taken
cards.text: The bomb team was arrested at a roadblock. Radio Karzan is broadcasting their confessions, and Vael has recalled its ambassador for consultations.

choices.label: Disown them
choices.hint: They were adventurers.

choices.label: Offer a prisoner trade
choices.hint: Get our men back.

cards.title: The Lost Briefcase
cards.text: A staff major left his briefcase on the Aldmark–Kestrel Cross express. It held the deployment plan for the whole southern flank. The briefcase has not been found.

choices.label: Redraw every plan
choices.hint: Weeks of work, but safe.

choices.label: Assume it went into a ditch
choices.hint: Nobody could have found it.

cards.title: The Vosk Knew
cards.text: The Vosk attack came exactly where the lost plans said our line was thinnest. Our divisions were caught reshuffling.

choices.label: Purge the General Staff
choices.hint: Heads for every stolen page.

choices.label: Call it bad luck
choices.hint: Nothing can be proved.

cards.title: Radio Karzan
cards.text: Every night Radio Karzan broadcasts the names of Kestrian prisoners, dance music and a honeyed voice asking Kestrian soldiers why they are dying for the Lord Protector.

choices.label: Jam the broadcasts
choices.hint: Transmitters on every hill.

choices.label: Answer with Radio Aldmark
choices.hint: Our own voice, our own music.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.hint: Nobody believes enemy propaganda.

cards.title: Cracks in the Greywater Dam
cards.text: Engineers report cracks spreading across the face of the great Greywater dam, weakened by the winter frosts. If it goes, the valley floods from the reservoir to the sea.

choices.label: Emergency repairs
choices.hint: Every engineer and every sack of cement.

choices.label: Evacuate the valley
choices.hint: Save the people, abandon the farms.

choices.label: Hope it holds
choices.hint: The engineers are always pessimists.

cards.title: THE GREYWATER DAM HAS BURST
cards.text: At dawn the Greywater dam gave way. A wall of water is roaring down the valley toward the sea.

choices.label: The Lord Protector goes to the valley
choices.hint: Be seen among the survivors.

choices.label: Blame the engineers
choices.hint: Somebody should have warned us.

cards.title: Influenza in the Training Depots
cards.text: A virulent influenza is sweeping the recruit depots around Aldmark. Recruits are dying before they ever see a trench.

choices.label: Close the depots
choices.hint: No new men for a month.

choices.label: Keep training
choices.hint: The front needs every man.

cards.title: The Depot Fever Reaches the City
cards.text: The influenza has escaped the barracks: the Aldmark tenements are full of it.

choices.label: Put the Ministry of Health in charge
choices.hint: Doctors, not generals.

choices.label: Put the army in charge
choices.hint: Cordons and curfews.

cards.title: Firedamp at Ironvale
cards.text: The mine inspectors have found firedamp gas building up in the deep galleries of the Ironvale colliery. Closing the pit means no coal for the steelworks for a month.

choices.label: Close the pit
choices.hint: Safety first.

choices.label: Keep digging
choices.hint: Ventilate as best they can.

cards.title: Explosion in the Ironvale Galleries
cards.text: The firedamp has exploded. The main shaft is choked and the colliery railway torn up.

choices.label: Everything for the rescue
choices.hint: The whole nation holds its breath.

choices.label: Seal the galleries
choices.hint: The fire must not spread.

cards.title: Something in the Water
cards.text: The Aldmark waterworks report a sewage main has burst into the city's filter beds. The chief engineer wants to chlorinate the whole supply at once, at great cost.

choices.label: Chlorinate at once
choices.hint: Expensive, and safe.

choices.label: Deny there is a problem
choices.hint: Panic would be worse than the water.

cards.title: Cholera in the Capital
cards.text: The first cases of cholera have appeared in the Aldmark river wards.

choices.label: Admit the failure
choices.hint: The truth, and the doctors.

choices.label: Arrest the waterworks engineers
choices.hint: Somebody must pay.

cards.title: Fires in the Stonereach
cards.text: A dry summer has set the Stonereach forests alight. The fires are racing toward the villages and the Stanhope rail tunnel.

choices.label: Send the army to fight the fires
choices.hint: Soldiers with shovels, not rifles.

choices.label: Let it burn out
choices.hint: The mountains will recover.

cards.title: The War Orphans
cards.text: The charities can no longer cope with the children of the dead: orphans are sleeping under the railway arches of every city.

choices.label: State orphanages
choices.hint: Every child fed and schooled.

choices.label: A national adoption drive
choices.hint: Every family can take one more.

choices.label: The state cannot afford it
choices.hint: The war comes first.

cards.title: BREAD AND BULLETS
cards.text: The Oppressive tax rate has broken the back of the working class. Riots have erupted in the industrial sector of Aldmark. The mob has seized a munitions depot and is demanding immediate tax relief, or they will detonate the stockpile.

cards.title: ALDMARK MUNITIONS BLAST
cards.text: During the military crackdown, a stray bullet struck a volatile artillery shell casing. The resulting explosion leveled three city blocks and severed the central rail line.

cards.title: THE VOSK SCIENTIST
cards.text: A high-ranking Vosk engineer has defected across the frozen Frontier. He offers the complete blueprints for their experimental Cold-Weather Equipment, but demands 150,000 CR to start a new life in neutral Oakhaven.

choices.label: Pay the man. We need that tech.
Throw him in a black site and extract it.

cards.title: R&D BREAKTHROUGH: WINTER GEAR
cards.text: The defector arrived safely in Oakhaven. True to his word, our agents recovered a dead-drop containing the schematics. Our R&D department can now mass-produce Winter Gear.

choices.label: Issue it to the men immediately.

cards.title: DEFECTOR FOUND DEAD
cards.text: The Vosk scientist died during our 'enhanced interrogation'. The blueprints were in his head, and now they are gone forever. The intelligence community is shaken.

cards.title: THE GHOST SHIP
cards.text: A Kestrian merchant marine vessel has drifted into the port of Brenmouth. The crew is dead or dying from a horrific, highly contagious strain of Cholera. Port authorities beg you to sink the ship before it docks.

choices.label: Sink the ship. God rest their souls.
We cannot murder our own citizens. Quarantine them.

cards.title: QUARANTINE BREACHED
cards.text: The port quarantine failed. Desperate sailors bribed the guards and escaped into Brenmouth. The infection is now spreading rapidly through the coastal population.
